ideas.idea: Add author and datePublished to the Article JSON-LD
ideas.why: Accurate, but the Article block is a thin, arguably unneeded markup on a pricing page, and the missing properties have little effect.

ideas.idea: Build canonical from Astro.url.pathname and a declared site origin
ideas.why: This is a concrete fix for the hardcoded canonical in Base.astro, using a mechanism that suits Astro.

ideas.idea: Show FAQ questions and answers as visible page text on the home page
ideas.why: The FAQ exists only in JSON-LD in index.astro, so visitors and machines can't see it as page content, and markup should match visible content.

ideas.idea: Add a booking link or instructions, since the description says 'Book a mooring'
ideas.why: The index description promises booking but the page has no way to book, which is accurate and actionable.

ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness/Offer structured data for prices and contact details
ideas.why: Prices on moorings.astro and the phone number on contact.astro are plain text, and labelling them helps machines read them.

ideas.idea: Link from the home page to /moorings in body text
ideas.why: The home page only reaches the prices page through the nav, so an in-content link is a specific and plausible improvement.
The index title says 'Harbor' while the body and descriptions say 'harbour', so the title doesn't match the language people search with.

ideas.idea: Add charset and viewport meta and a <main> element
ideas.why: Accurate for Base.astro, but it is standard hygiene that applies to nearly any site.

ideas.idea: Declare site in an astro.config so canonicals and sitemaps come from one source
ideas.why: There is no astro.config, and the sitemap is hand-written, so declaring site is accurate and supports the canonical fix.

ideas.idea: Mention GPTBot and ClaudeBot (training crawlers) in robots.txt
ideas.why: The report itself says this is a separate, unscored choice, so it is a low-impact observation.
